########################################
#
# Script contains the comparison of UMI-SPBC group sizes before and after
# adaptive filtering and the comparison of retained group size with the
# final consensus count
#
# N_ORIG versus N_KEEP is shown in the LongAIRR supplementary figures
# N_KEEP versus CONSENSUS_COUNT is used as a reviewer-only figure
#
########################################

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

read in and filter AIRR data
```{r}
dir_bcr <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv")
dir_tcr <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5/airr/tr_p_parse-select.tsv")

p2459_airr <- bind_rows(
  read.csv(dir_bcr, sep = "\t"),
  read.csv(dir_tcr, sep = "\t")
) %>%
  mutate(v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                                     start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus &
           !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction) &
           !grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
```

--------------------N_ORIG versus N_KEEP--------------
--------------adaptive-filter retention---------------
------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
f1_threshold <- 1
f2_threshold <- 2
f3_threshold <- 3

# Adaptive filtering is only applied for groups with N_ORIG > 4
adaptive_filter_min_n_orig <- 5

density_cap <- 1000
label_size <- 2.6

p2459_af_plot <- p2459_airr %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_orig), !is.na(n_keep), n_orig > 0, n_keep > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    af_processed = n_orig >= adaptive_filter_min_n_orig,
    # AF-processed groups affected by at least one downstream filter
    af_affected_by_filter = af_processed & n_keep <= f3_threshold
  )

highlight_groups <- p2459_af_plot %>%
  filter(af_affected_by_filter)

background_groups <- p2459_af_plot %>%
  filter(!af_affected_by_filter)
```

prepare axes and annotation labels
```{r}
axis_breaks_all <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 30, 100, 150, 300, 750, 1500, 3000, 7500, 10000, 30000)

plot_max <- max(p2459_af_plot$n_orig, p2459_af_plot$n_keep, na.rm = TRUE)
plot_max_nice <- min(axis_breaks_all[axis_breaks_all >= plot_max])
axis_breaks <- axis_breaks_all[axis_breaks_all <= plot_max_nice]

right_label_x <- plot_max_nice / 10^0.025
af_label_x <- adaptive_filter_min_n_orig * 10^0.035
af_label_y <- 750 / 10^0.12

n_af_processed <- p2459_af_plot %>%
  filter(af_processed) %>%
  nrow()

filter_cutoff_counts <- tibble(
  filter = c("F1", "F2", "F3"),
  threshold = c(f1_threshold, f2_threshold, f3_threshold)
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_below_cutoff = map_int(
      threshold,
      ~ sum(p2459_af_plot$af_processed & p2459_af_plot$n_keep <= .x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    fraction = n_below_cutoff / n_af_processed,
    label = paste0(
      "Below ", filter, ":  n=", label_number()(n_below_cutoff),
      " (", percent(fraction, accuracy = 0.01), ")"
    )
  )

f1_label <- filter_cutoff_counts %>% filter(filter == "F1") %>% pull(label)
f2_label <- filter_cutoff_counts %>% filter(filter == "F2") %>% pull(label)
f3_label <- filter_cutoff_counts %>% filter(filter == "F3") %>% pull(label)

af_denominator_label <- paste0(
  "AF-processed groups\n",
  "n = ", label_number()(n_af_processed)
)
```

generate N_ORIG versus N_KEEP scatter
```{r}
density_cols <- c("grey85", "grey60", "grey40", "grey20", "black")
affected_point_col <- "#D62728"

p_norig_nkeep_filters <- ggplot() +
  geom_bin2d(data = background_groups, aes(x = n_orig, y = n_keep), bins = 90) +
  geom_point(data = highlight_groups, aes(x = n_orig, y = n_keep),
             color = affected_point_col, shape = 15, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = adaptive_filter_min_n_orig, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.35, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = adaptive_filter_min_n_orig, xend = plot_max_nice,
           y = f1_threshold, yend = f1_threshold, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.45, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = adaptive_filter_min_n_orig, xend = plot_max_nice,
           y = f2_threshold, yend = f2_threshold, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.45, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = adaptive_filter_min_n_orig, xend = plot_max_nice,
           y = f3_threshold, yend = f3_threshold, linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.45, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = af_label_x, y = af_label_y, label = "AF min-size:\nN_ORIG > 4",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = label_size, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = right_label_x, y = 7, label = af_denominator_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = label_size, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = right_label_x, y = f3_threshold, label = f3_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = label_size, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = right_label_x, y = f2_threshold, label = f2_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = label_size, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = right_label_x, y = f1_threshold * 10^0.035, label = f1_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = label_size, color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = axis_breaks,
    labels = label_number(),
    limits = c(1, plot_max_nice),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = axis_breaks,
    labels = label_number(),
    limits = c(1, plot_max_nice),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    name = "Number of groups",
    colours = density_cols,
    trans = "log10",
    limits = c(1, density_cap),
    oob = squish,
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100, density_cap),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100", paste0("≥", label_number()(density_cap)))
  ) +
  #coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "N_ORIG", y = "N_KEEP") +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 7) +
      theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(r=2, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
  # theme(
  #   text = element_text(color = "black"),
  #   axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
  #   axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
  #   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
  #   legend.position = "bottom",
  #   legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
  #   legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
  #   panel.grid = element_blank(),
  #   panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
  #   plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 0),
  #   panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  #   plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  # )
```

--------------------N_KEEP versus CONSENSUS_COUNT--------------
--------------consensus subsampling-----------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
subsample_threshold <- 750

p2459_count_scatter <- p2459_airr %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_keep), !is.na(consensus_count), n_keep > 0, consensus_count > 0) %>%
  mutate(is_identical_count = consensus_count == n_keep)

identical_counts <- p2459_count_scatter %>%
  filter(is_identical_count)

capped_counts <- p2459_count_scatter %>%
  filter(!is_identical_count)
```

prepare axes
```{r}
plot_max_count <- max(
  p2459_count_scatter$n_keep,
  p2459_count_scatter$consensus_count,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

plot_max_count_nice <- min(axis_breaks_all[axis_breaks_all >= plot_max_count])
axis_breaks_count <- axis_breaks_all[axis_breaks_all <= plot_max_count_nice]
```

generate N_KEEP versus CONSENSUS_COUNT scatter
```{r}
p_nkeep_consensus <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = identical_counts, aes(x = n_keep, y = consensus_count),
             size = 1.1, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = capped_counts, aes(x = n_keep, y = consensus_count),
             color = "#D62728", size = 1.1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = plot_max_count_nice,
           y = subsample_threshold, yend = subsample_threshold,
           linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.45, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = subsample_threshold,
           label = "Subsampling cap: n = 750",
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = axis_breaks_count,
    labels = label_number(),
    limits = c(1, plot_max_count_nice),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = axis_breaks_count,
    labels = label_number(),
    limits = c(1, plot_max_count_nice),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  #coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "N_KEEP", y = "CONSENSUS_COUNT") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(r=2, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
  # theme(
  #   text = element_text(color = "black"),
  #   axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
  #   axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),

  # )
```
